about: Shrinks tool output, logs and files before they reach an AI model, so coding agents use fewer tokens.

prs.title: Merge diffs keep changes made against the second parent
prs.broken: When shrinking a merge diff, changes made against a later parent were treated as plain context and could be cut away.
prs.changed: Each line is now judged by all of its parent columns. Ordinary diffs behave as before.
prs.matters: An AI agent reading a shortened merge diff still sees every change.

prs.title: Shortened diffs keep their line numbers right
prs.broken: When shrinking a diff, the tool cut context lines but kept the old line numbers in each section's heading, so every line read off it was in the wrong place.
prs.changed: Each trimmed section is now split at its gaps and gets a new heading worked out from what is left.
prs.matters: An AI agent or patch tool using the short diff edits the right lines.
